rows.grounds: numeral component qualifying the following thousands
locative plural indicating the count within which torment occurs
compound of yoni and yantra denoting realms or devices of birth
past passive participle describing the afflicted state of beings

items.question: In what vast array of womb-mechanisms are beings said to be tormented?
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The subject of pīḍitāḥ is implied from context rather than explicitly stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
